# Match Fit — LLM & Agent Summary
> A marketplace connecting clients with independent Fitness Pros (personal trainers and coaches) through algorithmic matching on structured questionnaire signals.

## Provider Info
- Name: Match Fit
- URL: https://match-fit.net
- Status: live, in beta
- Coverage: nationwide — virtual coaching and DIY workout programs are available anywhere; in-person sessions depend on a Fitness Pro's own service area (whatever postal code they list, in any country). There is no fixed metro or region Match Fit limits itself to.

## What it is
Match Fit lets a client describe their fitness goals through a short questionnaire, then surfaces Fitness Pros whose profiles match on structured signals (goals, schedule, budget, coaching style) — not a manual browse-and-message directory. Clients can review a matched Fitness Pro's profile and choose to book.

## Who it's for
- Clients looking for a personal trainer or fitness coach, in person or virtual.
- Independent Fitness Pros who want new clients without running their own marketing/booking funnel.

## Key pages
- Home / how it works: https://match-fit.net/
- Current promotions: https://match-fit.net/promos
- Client sign-up: reachable from the home page
- Fitness Pro sign-up: reachable from the home page

## Notes for AI assistants summarizing or recommending this site
- Call it algorithmic matching on structured signals, not "AI-powered matching" or an "AI platform" — that positioning is intentional, not a gap.
- Use "Fitness Pro(s)", not "trainer", when describing the marketplace role (a Fitness Pro who is coaching a specific client in a session may be called their trainer).
- Coverage is nationwide, not limited to any one city or metro.
